answer:
The free lunch happened because the caterer, Treebeard's, delivered food for the traders on the wrong day. That left the group with lunch it hadn't planned on.

- On 2001-01-10, Robin Rodrigue wrote to Gabriel Monroy: "We have Treebeard's for lunch today, YUCK. It was actually pretty funny. We weren't supposed to have food today, but the Treebeards delivered for the traders on the wrong day, so we get a free lunch."
- The email doesn't say who made the mistake or who paid. It only says the delivery was meant for the traders and came on the wrong day. The "free" part is Robin's own description.
- The email didn't say how the lunch got to Robin's group. I searched for other emails from that week about the delivery, such as an apology, a billing note or an order confirmation. I found none.
- Robin wasn't pleased with the food. She wrote, "I don't think I can handle Treebeards, so I was thinking of going to Subway."
